findings.title: Modified config copy is discarded; raw monitor config returned in event context
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context, the monitor's config is copied and config["schedule_type"] is rewritten to the human-readable display value, but the returned context dict uses monitor_environment.monitor.config (the original, unmodified dict) instead of the modified copy. This makes the schedule_type display conversion dead code, and every monitor incident occurrence event carries the raw integer schedule_type in its monitor context rather than the readable label. This defect was carried verbatim from the old create_issue_platform_occurrence in mark_failed.py; the fix is to return "config": config (the copy) instead of "config": monitor_environment.monitor.config.
